messages:
morgan: 🚩 bringing up scallop7b-int4 on canary nodes. initial perf looks good for short chats but seeing OOMs after ~800 tokens in long sessions
ellie: rough numbers? p95 latency, memory growth pattern?
morgan: p95 ~220ms for 1-2 turns. memory climbs steadily during generation, jumps right before OOM. heap fragmentation traces show many small free segments.
sanjay: could be prefetch window + aggressive KV retention. what's prefetch_window and slot_reserve in the canary config?
morgan: we used defaults: prefetch_window=16, slot_reserve=0.1, max_new_tokens defaulted to 256 (that's from the quickstart template)
tia: 256 for max_new_tokens is probably too high for our default route. lots of long-tail chats + streaming cause KV growth. suggest lowering default to 64 or 96 while we debug.
ellie: agree. also try turning on opportunistic KV prune for long sessions. On scallop int4 quant we saw tombstone fragmentation in the allocator at ~600 tokens before.
morgan: trying two quick changes on canary: 1) max_new_tokens -> 64, 2) prefetch_window -> 8, 3) slot_reserve -> 0.2. deploying now:
```json
{ "model": "scallop7b-int4", "prefetch_window": 8, "slot_reserve": 0.2, "max_new_tokens": 64 }
```
deploy-bot: deploy requested by morgan for service=scallop7b-int4, env=canary, sha=ab12c3
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded in 2 clusters (canary-a, canary-b)
morgan: running synthetic convo that reproduces the leak now (10k token conversation simulator)
sanjay: also add this quick runtime flag to the worker: `--kv-eviction-mode=aggressive` — that will trim prefetched KV beyond current window quicker
morgan: added flag to canary worker, reloading config
morgan: after changes, ran 10 synthetic sessions: no OOMs, memory plateaued ~1.2GB lower than before, latency similar. queueing a 24h soak now.
ellie: nice. can you capture heap histogram and allocator free-list before/after? want to confirm fragmentation fix vs just reducing resident working set
morgan: attached short dumps to the canary logs (link) — before: lots of ~64-256B fragments, after: contiguous free spans increased, fragmentation ratio down 18%
tia: for safety, let's also add a fallback model variant: scallop7b-int8-prefetch to the routing policy for sessions >512 tokens. config suggestion:
```yaml
routing:
  - condition: session_length_predicted > 512
    fallback_model: scallop7b-int8-prefetch
    ttl: 30m
```
sanjay: good idea. int8 variant reduces memory pressure and keeps latency within SLO for long chats. we can make this toggleable per-customer.
morgan: will open a follow-up PR with (a) default max_new_tokens -> 64 (b) suggest prefetch_window 8 for int4 variants (c) add routing fallback for long sessions.
tia: also add an eval: run lm-eval on our conversational subset to ensure quality/regression after int4 patch. include BLEU/ROUGE + 3 human checks for hallucination.
ellie: can you report back after 24h soak? if stable we'll roll to dedicated canaries and schedule a release next week.
morgan: will report. current soak + logs -> https://redwood.internal/canary/scallop7b/2350001111
deploy-bot: alert: canary soak reached 24h threshold for scallop7b-int4, status=healthy
morgan: soak passed. opening PR now with rollout plan and perf graphs. short-term mitigation worked, will follow up with allocator compacting patch next sprint. :thumbsup:
